scares.description: Accompanied by a high pitched sound effect, a fast moving figure passes Cameron.
After a long build up, Cameron looks upwards and a woman drops down from the ceiling and attacks him.
A man appears at a window startling Dr. Ember.
A sound effect plays as Cameron suddenly lunges at Dr. Ember.
Dr. Ember suddenly pushes Dan off a chair.
Cameron suddenly grabs Dan’s arm and breaks it.
Dan begins talking from behind Dr. Ember.
Dr. Ember goes through a door and is attacked by a demon.
A high pitched sound plays as Dr. Ember starts convulsing.
